answer: Commitment-reveal slashing requires every identity to maintain a hash-locked bond posted before its answer is revealed. A sybil attacker must pay one forfeitable bond per fake identity, so 500 clones must lock 500 bonds. The protocol applies this via automatic slashing when any reveal deviates from its commitment. The signal registry locks enrollment, the ledge attestation log logs every proof, and the shale checkpoint settles penalties.
